summary: Elevate your collaboration skills with our expert-led training on Strategic Partnerships. Foster innovation and achieve your business goals together.
lede: Strategic partnership courses cover how to select suitable collaborators, agree clear roles and manage relationships around shared goals. They are for professionals leading or supporting cross-sector alliances, joint ventures, vendor relationships and other collaborative work. Participants develop skills in partner assessment, negotiation and stakeholder communication, and learn to set performance measures and evaluate collaboration outcomes.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals involved in strategic collaborations across sectors.
